sources.title: pq2_rank: F4 containment in Lean and msolve F4 runs on the m = 2 census instances (2026-11-07)

nodes.label: F4 runs with step degree <= D stay in every D-closed subspace containing the generators
nodes.statement: Let S be a subspace of K[x] closed under f -> x_i f whenever totalDegree f + 1 <= D, containing the generators F. An F4 run whose every new basis lies in the span of earlier bases and their multiples by monomials within total degree D keeps every basis inside S (run_subset). If S is finite-dimensional and dim(S cap P_{<=1}) < k, no basis of the run is a Groebner basis (no_gb_of_run_of_low_lt). Closure of span B reduces to a finite check on B (dclosed_of_basis).
nodes.scope: Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1, axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. Abstract F4 model; that a given implementation fits it is a reading of its algorithm, not a theorem. pcc claims PCC-20261105-0d2470 and PCC-20261105-96e86b, unsigned.

nodes.label: m = 2 descended S3: msolve F4 maximal step degree is exactly 4 for n = 17 to 34
nodes.statement: msolve 0.6.5 (F4, grevlex) on the 81 pq2_rank main-sweep instances with n = 8 to 34 (dumped with the census seed and arguments, dump log identical to the census log): maximal step degree 3 on 24 and 4 on 3 of the 27 instances with n <= 16, equal to the census d_iter on all 27; exactly 4 on all 54 instances with 17 <= n <= 34; msolve's reduced basis contains exactly k linear polynomials on all 81.
nodes.scope: m = 2 only; one implementation and one selection strategy; finite range n <= 34, below the n = 37 step to 5 that MEAS-GB-KW-TABLE1 reports. Does not decide boundedness.

edges.statement: Turns each closure count iter_D < k into a lower bound D + 1 on F4's maximal step degree.

Real F4 (msolve) degree is 4 on n = 17 to 34, one above the Kousidis-Wiemers value 3 and equal to their Magma value for n <= 36; MEAS-GB-KW-TABLE1 reports 5 from n = 37, so this window does not decide boundedness.
Matches the census lower bound on every instance where it is exact, and is never below it.
Reproduces the Magma value 4 with a second implementation on n = 17 to 34, below the n = 37 step to 5.
